text: I came here for full mouth restoration, starting with a deep cleaning and some fillings. The surface of the fillings was left very rough with large chunks protruding from the teeth. restaurant_name: White Teeth Dental Clinic - Banchang branch
text:
I give it a 10/10 in many aspects:
1. They provide excellent dental advice. They thoroughly check information, X-rays, and use modern equipment before starting work.
2. A tooth that previously needed extraction at another dentist was filled here. I really regret the previous extraction.
3. They also offer gum treatment services.
4. They have many specialist dentists in various fields of oral health.
5. The prices are affordable, and they accept social security and company insurance.
6. Many of the dentists are very gentle. Many children come here with their parents.

restaurant_name: White Teeth Dental Clinic - Banchang branch
text: For anyone needing dental work done, I highly recommend this clinic. The service is excellent, from the front desk staff to the dental assistants and the dentists themselves. I had my teeth cleaned here, and the dentist was very attentive and gentle, even paying attention to small details during the procedure. I've had teeth cleaning done more than 10 times before, at both private clinics and public hospitals, and this clinic excels in service, the expertise of its doctors, and the use of modern equipment. 👍👍

text: Anyone needing braces, I highly recommend this clinic! It's really, really good. restaurant_name: White Teeth Dental Clinic - Banchang branch
text: Two fixed retainers on the inside of my teeth fell off, so I had to get them reattached, and they were charging me 1,700 baht. Another clinic was charging 500 baht, but I thought that was too expensive, so I went to a smaller clinic. After the procedure, they charged me even more. They eventually lowered the price to 800 baht, but I wish I had just gone to a larger clinic. Their skills are poor. The ones I had in Korea were bonded very thinly, and I've been using them for over 10 years. Their bonding here is so thick that it's uncomfortable. It's not only expensive compared to other clinics, but also incredibly expensive considering their skill level. In Korea, it would cost around 10,000-15,000 won (250-300 baht). If you're not in a hurry, I recommend going to Korea.
